newsitem.title: UK: ROTTERDAM BUNKERS SLIP $3 AFTER BARGE LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: ROTTERDAM BUNKERS SLIP $3 AFTER BARGE LOSSES.

text.p: Bunker prices fell $3 a tonne on Thursday in Rotterdam and other north European ports, tracking weaker crude oil and soft bulk fuel prices.
Heavy fuel barge prices traded down to $94 in Rotterdam with 380 cst selling at $96 to $97 free-on-board, compared to nearer $99.50 on Wednesday.
Gas oil also slipped as IPE futures sank around $2 a tonne, but traders said activity was generally slow.
Brokers said bunker demand had picked up during the afternoon to perhaps 20,000 tonnes after a slow morning.
Hamburg track Rotterdam prices lower but stayed at a premium of around $2 a tonne.
Mediterranean prices were unchanged but prices in Durban edged up $2.
